sources.t: Automatic compensation: What you need to know
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; explains automatic compensation for delayed repairs, missed appointments and delayed service starts from participating broadband and landline providers.
sources.g: Compensation eligibility presupposes a customer relationship and does not prove exact-address orderability.

sources.t: One million people have mapped their mobile
sources.f: Published 29 May 2026; reports use of Ofcom's postcode-based mobile checker and its mix of crowdsourced and predicted network data.
sources.g: Mobile checker use and predicted coverage are not fixed-broadband parcel truth.

sources.t: Can’t get a signal? Map Your Mobile launch
sources.f: Published 26 June 2025; launched Ofcom's local mobile coverage and performance comparison service.
sources.g: Local mobile predictions and postal-district performance do not establish a fixed parcel connection.

sources.t: Map Your Mobile checker
sources.f: Official postcode checker presents predicted indoor and outdoor coverage plus postal-district performance information.
sources.g: Predictions can differ from experience and cannot be promoted to exact parcel service truth.

sources.t: Map Your Mobile coverage checker update
sources.f: Updated 8 August 2025; documents thresholds, 50-metre coverage squares and crowdsourced performance additions.
sources.g: Methodology and predicted mobile coverage do not guarantee current service at a premises.

sources.t: Coverage and speeds collection
sources.f: Official collection indexes current coverage, speed, checker and Connected Nations material.
sources.g: A collection page is discovery evidence, not parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Phones and broadband collection
sources.f: Official landing page organises broadband access, accessibility, billing, coverage, landline and mobile guidance.
sources.g: A thematic landing page cannot establish current exact-address availability.

sources.t: Accessibility for phones and broadband
sources.f: Official accessibility collection indexes rules, research and consumer support for disabled communications users.
sources.g: Accessibility obligations and research are not evidence of network reach at a parcel.

sources.t: General Conditions of Entitlement
sources.f: Updated 8 April 2026; explains the regulatory conditions applicable to providers of electronic communications networks and services.
sources.g: Provider regulation does not prove infrastructure build or retail availability at an address.

sources.t: January 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; monthly contract-level management information with rounded figures and initial-scope limitations.
sources.g: Rounded, lagged contract reporting is not exact current retail orderability.

sources.t: February 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; monthly Project Gigabit contracted and built premises reporting.
sources.g: Contract-level management information cannot be promoted to parcel service truth.

sources.t: December 2025 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; snapshot uses rounded initial-scope contract data and notes ingestion lag.
sources.g: Historic rounded snapshots do not establish current exact-premises connectivity.

sources.t: November 2025 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; monthly table of contracted and built premises with rounding and comparability cautions.
sources.g: Aggregate contract records require fresh UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: October 2025 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; first monthly contract-level publication in the collection.
sources.g: Historic programme reporting is not current parcel orderability evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract Kent
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; records redesign of the Kent CityFibre contract to around 9,000 premises.
sources.g: Redesigned contract scope and investment are planning evidence, not active service proof.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract North Shropshire
sources.f: Updated 14 April 2026; records descoping of a Freedom Fibre contract and transfer of premises into an Openreach call-off.
sources.g: Contract changes do not prove completed service at an individual premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract Derbyshire Peak District
sources.f: Updated 10 April 2026; records termination of the FullFibre contract and inclusion in an Openreach call-off.
sources.g: Replacement procurement status is not exact-address availability evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contracts Cornwall
sources.f: Updated 12 February 2026; records partial withdrawal from two Cornwall contracts after reported delivery to around 13,200 premises.
sources.g: Regional contract delivery and withdrawal figures do not establish current service for a parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit East Sussex Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; official consultation outcome indexes closure, postcode map and postcode-list material.
sources.g: Public-review classifications and maps require current exact-premises validation.

sources.t: Leicestershire and Warwickshire Public Review Closure Notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; records historic public-review outcomes and a May 2026 contract redesign to around 36,000 premises.
sources.g: Historic classifications and redesigned procurement scope are not live parcel connectivity evidence.
